findings.detail: Cross-account integration tests are not evidenced by source inspection.
findings.action: Add two-account tests for notifications, ledger, recommendations, follows, profile and applications.

findings.detail: Self-demotion is blocked, but last-admin protection and full audit logging for admin user mutation are not established.
findings.action: Review and test last-admin invariants and audit trail.

findings.detail: Admin passes author role gate, but author novel collection remains filtered to admin's own owner ID.
findings.action: Document intended admin collection semantics and test.

findings.detail: Taxonomy submissions retain public access, but submitter attribution is now derived from the verified session and IP rate limiting is applied. Runtime abuse testing remains outstanding.
findings.action: Add browser/runtime tests for anonymous and authenticated submissions, spoof attempts and rate-limit behavior.

findings.detail: Remaining API routes, CSRF/origin, DTO allowlists, private caching and runtime object isolation are not certified.
findings.action: Continue handler review and runtime integration tests.

findings.detail: Admin report status changes now check affected rows and emit an audit event with report id and resulting status.
findings.action: Verify audit event persistence and failure behavior against isolated D1.

findings.detail: Administrator account PATCH now updates only explicitly supplied fields, rejects empty/unknown updates, protects the last active admin, and batches the account change with a conditional audit row. Static checks and SQLite transaction tests pass; live D1 concurrency testing remains outstanding.
findings.action: Run isolated D1 concurrency and audit-failure tests before security sign-off.

findings.detail: Donation approval uses a pending-only status transition followed by conditional balance credit and ledger insertion in a D1 batch. SQLite integration tests now cover successful approval, replay prevention and ledger-failure rollback.
findings.action: Verify the same behavior with isolated Cloudflare D1 integration tests and concurrent duplicate approvals.

findings.detail: Taxonomy submissions retain public access, but submitter attribution is now derived from the verified session and IP rate limiting is applied. Runtime abuse testing remains outstanding.
findings.action: Add browser/runtime tests for anonymous and authenticated submissions, spoof attempts and rate-limit behavior.

findings.detail: Public vote listing includes requester username. This is public profile metadata exposure, but the intended disclosure policy is not documented in the handler.
findings.action: Confirm usernames are intentionally public on the vote board; keep email and private account fields excluded.

findings.detail: State-changing API requests now reject mismatched Origin headers and Sec-Fetch-Site=cross-site before schema bootstrap/session lookup; SameSite=Lax remains defense-in-depth. Browser/runtime CSRF tests remain outstanding.
findings.action: Add real browser tests for same-origin POST, cross-origin form POST, missing Origin and Fetch Metadata edge cases.

findings.detail: Story Bible generation and chapter generation now require strict project ownership even for administrators, so job/run owner_user_id remains aligned with the project owner. Admin read/oversight routes retain their separately gated access.
findings.action: Add two-account runtime tests proving admin and other authors cannot generate against a creator-owned project and owner job history remains correctly attributed.

findings.detail: Both public comment reads and authenticated comment writes now require the parent novel to be published and rights eligible.
findings.action: Run isolated D1 tests for missing, draft, rights-ineligible and eligible parent novels.

findings.detail: The current rating API accepts and rounds whole-number ratings from 1 to 5, while the product requirements specify a whole-number 1-to-10 scale. The source also contains a second legacy POST /api/rating handler after the first matching handler, creating duplicate route logic with inconsistent rights eligibility checks; the first matching handler returns, so the later block appears unreachable in the current dispatch flow.
findings.action: Resolve the product rating contract before migration. Inventory schema constraints, UI controls, stored ratings and all consumers; design an explicit migration/normalization plan and remove the duplicate legacy handler only with regression tests. Do not change the scale by simply widening the API bound.
